Work with Object Links

Opt   Object link            Type             Attribute    Text

notes: Option 12 appears with DETAIL(*EXTENDED). Root listing shows QDLS, QFileSvr, QIBM, QNTC, QOpenSys, QOPT, QSR, QSYS.LIB directories.
